transcriber_notes: Old small template: 13 labels (OCT ... SEP, OCT) on the 13 dashed month-boundary lines, so the first column is OCT. Only a "Peak rainy season" (Jun-Sep) is drawn, so planting (Mar-Jun) starts before it; links point to it as the only rainy season shown. "Off-season cropping" (Jan-Feb) is gold but not labelled as a harvest; unlinked.
